items.note: The plan gets the subtract-add-undo schedule right, with net change (JV+RG)x independent of the scratch values, the bit central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 cancelled on intersection-one pairs, and the three stages giving (-Y,X) with scratch restored (lines 741-764). It leaves out the complex case (coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, even-intersection neighbours, lines 756-758), which the complex network needs, and never gives h=100, N, m or the wire counts.

The plan states D_out S D_in^{-1}, the edge change D_v D_u^{-1}, and the stored-array invariant carried through each gate because a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate, as in lines 804-817. The route formula epsilon_w D_sink D_source^{-1} appears only as the remark that intermediate frames cancel along a route.

The plan gives nested nondegenerate labels, orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, the central-wire 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones (each losing h, Ic of them), the telescoping to Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. It never shows the bilinear forms, the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels, lines 975-988) or the residual table (1022-1043). The F_2 orthonormal-basis part (1073-1102) is also absent.

The plan covers the projection matrices as frames, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, one extra rank per negative source projection, s=Wm-N+2L<Wm with deficit N-2L>0, and the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m giving H<-H+D. This follows lines 1156-1171.

The plan gives the phase frame, weight additivity mod 4 over orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving the kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse, the count Wm-2N+2L with deficit 2N-2L, and C^{tensor m} on every role after corrections. It does not show how the endpoint correction works: on X_a->Y_a the operator has C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates, and Z-conjugation with the phase i^{27k} turns it into C (lines 1290-1310).

The plan states L/N<1/2, s<Wm for both networks, and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. It does not derive the exponent: the relative deficits eta_b and eta_c, eta>20*2^{-50}, and log m<20 (lines 1319-1338) are all absent.

The four elementary operations are only quoted from the lemma statement, with no derivation. The controlled-shift step omits the condition that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time and the prime/unit hypotheses (lines 557-568). Its split-and-merge rotation and the c-piece multiplication do match lines 575-598.

The plan states the factorisation and the shear cost correctly, and the shear proof (triangular factors by controlled shifts, conjugation, one interchange per one of Pi) follows lines 1425-1443. The elimination proof of the factorisation (lines 1375-1391) and the choice of the prime q (1413-1423) are not given.

The plan follows the paper's route step by step: cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, frames Phi_M giving H<-H+D on every row, three shears, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^tau), and the depth-first fixed-tape schedule at O(V) per node.
The plan builds the row field from high digits, splits the rest into base-m pieces summed geometrically to O(Ve^tau), and pads binary chunks to radix q for O(Vu^tau). This matches lines 1649-1733.

The plan has the conjugation by P_M with one child per residual vector on f=e/m axes, s_c children in total, C^{tensor e} on every role, and the identity H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. Two steps are missing: the inverse-child identity (eq:phase-inverse-child) and the reduction of P_M to a fixed number of row additions by Gaussian elimination (lines 1883-1900).

The route matches the paper: eight conditional additions, each a single cyclic shift of a chunk range, the bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, and T_0S_0^{-1} permuting only the bad set, repaired by sorting. The lemma's time bound O(V(L^tau+1)+...) is never stated.

The plan gives the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), internal overhead O(e^lambda), the base-m pieces and the final lambda' condition. The leaf bound O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) (lines 2420-2427), which produces the sigma+beta(1-sigma) term, is only named in the method. The q_0 row construction (2306-2323) is also absent.

The plan gives the exact Gaussian-dyadic evaluation with ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) guard bits, a single truncation with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, and cost O(Vd^{lambda'}). The guard-width derivation (the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E) is not reconstructed.

The plan covers the character cancellation, bit-reversed order, rounds grouped into a parallel butterfly plus a monomial, the prefix-slot and chunk-exchange layout costs, the per-round layer cost, the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, and the stored order L(Bj). This matches the paper.

The plan's derivation steps (four absolute-value products, no collision at B_0=2^{4p}, centred extraction, negacyclic wrap) follow the paper. The statement omits that the lemma returns Q_p(fg/r), with the normalisation by r and the truncation error.
The plan has the retained LB order, pointwise products commuting with a record permutation, the exact scaling by M, the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost, as in the paper.

The plan gives P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with both permutations left inside, the Neumann inversion, contractions, error p^2 and cost, plus the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2 and the axis-exposure cost. The exact Gaussian identity is cited, as the paper itself cites it.

Both identities are stated, and the cancellation is derived through R being a dilation by a unit. The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined, and the Bluestein identity is supported by a single quote with no derivation.
The plan covers the fixed exponents, the sizes, the prime windows with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, deterministic trial division, and the absence of wraparound, matching the paper.
The plan has the isomorphism Phi, the triangular update b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i}a_jP_j in descending i, prefix-controlled shifts, and the cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), as in the paper.
The plan gives the well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, the cancellation of the negative wrap, and the isometries making M_C a contraction. The computed twist error of 4*2^{-p} is not given.

The plan covers the source transform and its exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, the six algorithm steps, and the two S normalisations. The input scaling by 2^{-b-2} is not mentioned, and the S9.5 headline's '2^{2b+4}' should read 2^{2b+4}S (S9.5.6 has it right).
The plan chains the error bounds through the ring convolution, the chirp, E_s, the product and E_w to below 1/2, then rounds and propagates carries, as in the paper.
The plan has the normalised cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^{-181}=2kappa, the polylog absorption, the final bound, and schoolbook multiplication below the cutoff, matching the paper.
S0 relies on nlogn-conjecture and its motivation talks about beating n log n. No step states the eventual-lower-bound formulation or the liminf negation (lines 381-387).

errors.says: after the opposite transform, rescale by S and 2^{2b+4}
errors.paper: The second scale multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S, not 2^{2b+4} (steps 4-5 of the algorithm, lines 4517-4523; explained at 4536-4540).

errors.says: a product of two disk-grid polynomials is computed exactly ... in time O(rp log(rp))
errors.paper: The lemma computes the exact numerators of fg and then returns Q_p(fg/r), with error below sqrt2 2^{-p} (lines 3228-3231). The plan omits the normalisation by r and the truncation.

errors.says: cyclically shifting or rescaling a later field by control fields
errors.paper: The shift offset depends on the control fields, but rescaling is multiplication by a fixed rational unit, not by the controls (lines 569-570).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: bank-exchange network, frames, labels, rank budget s<Wm, the bit and phase interfaces, the matrix-shear interchange recurrence, the butterfly-layer recurrence, then the transform, convolution and resampling reduction and the cost table with kappa=2^{-182}. It thins out where the exponent tau=1-2^{-50} is obtained from s<Wm (no eta values, no log m<20 argument), where the network is never quantified (no h=100, N or m), and in the complex endpoint correction and the layer recurrence's leaf bound. Apart from those gaps it reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) without a break.

steps.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X), the restoration of scratch wires and the use of 3-subsets are all present. The plan never fixes h=100, the triple indexing of X_a and Y_a, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3, so the network's defining quantities are missing.
The plan has the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costing only the change D_vD_u^{-1}.

The plan gives nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from tensor products of triple lines, comparable labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h.
S3.4.1 states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and S3.4's method adds one extra rank per negative source projection (the N exceptions of rank one).
The plan has the sum Wm-2N+2L, with Ic decreasing edges of loss h (L=Ich), and s=Wm-N+2L for the bit network.
The plan gives the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, the deficit N-2L>0 so that s<Wm, and the complex deficit 2N-2L.
S3.4.3 gives the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on every role, which makes the shear H<-H+D.
The plan has the E_1 Pi E_2 factorisation, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.

The children of volume V/W, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all stated. The plan never shows why tau=1-2^{-50} works (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, lines 1331-1338), so the verdict is conservative.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the core of the central saving, C2 through C8: frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget, the strict deficit, the endpoint identity and edges as recursive calls. Two links are incomplete. The network is never quantified (no h=100, N or m), and the explicit exponent is asserted without its eta and log m justification, so C1 and C9 are only mentioned.
